## 07｜内景 June 家／Vera 工作室—7:02 PM

June：“Hey, Bean. I'm home—”　（中文翻译：嘿，Bean。我回来了——）

邮件：“Voss Sound: Love the song. You need a band.”

汇合到：Vera：“Stay in tonight, June. I mean it.”

June（小声念）：“'LATE BLOOM… wants to hear you live…' By seven?”　（中文翻译：“LATE BLOOM……想听你现场……”七点前？）
